title: Bianca Belair vs. Becky Lynch: reclaiming her place
summary: Becky’s sudden return takes Bianca’s championship away in seconds. Belair rebuilds toward a WrestleMania rematch and a chance to reverse that humiliation.

chapters.title: Becky returns and takes the championship
chapters.result: Lynch defeats Belair in an impromptu SmackDown Women’s title match.
chapters.context: The abrupt loss begins Bianca’s pursuit of redemption.

chapters.title: Bianca wins the WrestleMania rematch
chapters.result: Belair defeats Lynch for the Raw Women’s Championship.
chapters.context: After both women move to Raw, Bianca overcomes the same opponent on the biggest stage.
